Maya (PM): Quick huddlewe need a concise invite workflow for a 6-week 'performance partners' beta focused on sub-200ms use cases. Thoughts on screening + launch stopgates?
Diego (Growth): Love it. Can we prioritize partners that map to productized features (chat, search-rerank, live transcripts)? Those give clear metrics.
Nina (Design): Screener should be 4 fields max. Proposed: 1) short feature blurb, 2) target p95, 3) expected QPS, 4) preferred incentive (credit/case-study). One-line microcopy for success needed.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): For invites we need to score quickly. Suggest a 3-factor rubric: technical fit (1-4), integration effort (1-4), measurable outcome (1-4). Threshold >=9. Also veto if on-prem-only.
Anya (SRE): Ops constraint: we can commit a small Reserved pool but only if partner accepts an explicit fallback to hosted variants. Need runbook + escalation contact before onboarding.
Jordan (Legal): If we're collecting traces or outputs, include a consent checkbox and offer log retention tiers (30/90/365). I'll draft a 2-line consent snippet.
deply-bot: merged: feature/beta-invites -> beta :tada:
Maya (PM): Nice. Launch gates idea: Recruit (>=12 qualified across personas), Staging (>=3 successful integrations in staging within 2 weeks), Safety (no single partner causes >15% SLO breach), Value (median latency improved by >=20% for at least 2 partners). Pause if any gate fails.
Diego (Growth): A/B test outreach subject: variant A "Help us hit 100ms" vs B "Lower your inference costs". Track reply-rate and converted integrations.
Nina (Design): I'll create two short banners for accepted partners: one productized tone, one technical. Also a 1-page onboarding cheat-sheet.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Onboarding checklist for staging: scoped API key, model pinned, baseline logs uploaded to S3 (consent), traffic mirror plan (0-10%), canary routing config snippet. I'll add a quick `curl` example.
Anya (SRE): Runbook checklist: alert thresholds, playbook to throttle non-critical traffic, responder rotation. We need oncall coverage windows in the invite.
Jordan (Legal): Consent snippet draft: "By participating you consent to share request/response logs for debugging. Redwood will retain logs for [30/90/365] days per your choice. We will not use your data for model training unless explicitly agreed"
Maya (PM): Incentives: $400 platform credit or joint case study + intro to PMs. We'll present both and let partners pick.
Diego (Growth): Also offer a fast-track integration slot to top 3 partners (priority Dedicated pool during testing). That will boost conversion.
Nina (Design): Microcopy for screener success checkbox: "Primary success: latency / cost / UX retention / relevance" (multi-select).
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Triage workflow: weekly scoring batch. I'll volunteer to gate invites and schedule staging runs.
Anya (SRE): I'll provide a minimal routing policy snippet to fall back to hosted models + rate-limits if capacity drops.
Jordan (Legal): I'll review final outreach and the consent box before send.
Maya (PM): Action list: Diego builds the form + A/B, Nina designs banner + screener copy, Ravi makes rubric + onboarding curl, Anya writes runbook template, Jordan final legal blurb. I'll assemble a 1-pager and share by Thursday EOD.
Diego (Growth): Will set up the HubSpot form and track UTM source.
Nina (Design): Will mock banners by Wed.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Will draft `curl` and canary routing snippet today.
Anya (SRE): Runbook stub in repo by tomorrow.
Jordan (Legal): Ping me when draft is ready.
Maya (PM): Great. If no objections we go live with outreach next Mon. :rocket:
